mapper.select: SELECT id, permit_no, address, community, lat, lng, stage, cover_photo_id, source_type, source_url, source_fetched_at, created_at, created_business_date, created_by, updated_at FROM house WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, house_id, stage, location_status, taken_at, taken_at_source, business_date, uploaded_at, uploaded_by, original_filename, content_type, file_size, gps_lat, gps_lng, distance_m FROM photo WHERE house_id = #{houseId} ORDER BY taken_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, permit_no, address, community, lat, lng, stage, cover_photo_id, source_type, source_url, source_fetched_at, created_at, created_business_date, created_by, updated_at FROM house WHERE permit_no = #{permitNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage_history (house_id, from_stage, to_stage, changed_by, changed_at) VALUES (#{houseId}, #{fromStage}, #{toStage}, #{changedBy}, #{changedAt})

INSERT INTO house (permit_no, address, community, lat, lng, stage, source_type, source_url, source_fetched_at, created_at, created_business_date, created_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{house.permitNo}, #{house.address}, #{house.community}, #{house.lat,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{house.lng,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{house.stage}, #{house.sourceType}, #{house.sourceUrl,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{house.sourceFetchedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{house.createdAt}, #{house.createdBusinessDate}, #{house.createdBy}, #{house.updatedAt})
